passages.text: “Now this is what you are to do to consecrate Aaron and his sons to serve Me as priests: Take a young bull and two rams without blemish, along with unleavened bread, unleavened cakes mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil. Make them out of fine wheat flour, put them in a basket, and present them in the basket, along with the bull and the two rams.
passages.sermon:
God chose Aaron and his sons to serve as priests.
God commanded Moses to consecrate Aaron and his sons for this service.
God told Moses to take a young bull.
The bull must be without blemish.
God told Moses to take two rams.
The rams must also be without blemish.
God told Moses to take unleavened bread.
God told Moses to take unleavened cakes mixed with oil.
God told Moses to take unleavened wafers anointed with oil.
Moses must make all these from fine wheat flour.
Moses must put the bread, cakes, and wafers in one basket.
Moses must present the basket with the bread, cakes, and wafers.
Moses must also present the bull and the two rams with the basket.
passages.original: וְזֶ֨ה הַדָּבָ֜ר אֲשֶֽׁר־ תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה לָהֶ֛ם לְקַדֵּ֥שׁ אֹתָ֖ם לְכַהֵ֣ן לִ֑י לְ֠קַח פַּ֣ר אֶחָ֧ד בֶּן־ בָּקָ֛ר וְאֵילִ֥ם שְׁנַ֖יִם תְּמִימִֽם׃ וְלֶ֣חֶם מַצּ֗וֹת וְחַלֹּ֤ת מַצֹּת֙ בְּלוּלֹ֣ת בַּשֶּׁ֔מֶן וּרְקִיקֵ֥י מַצּ֖וֹת מְשֻׁחִ֣ים בַּשָּׁ֑מֶן סֹ֥לֶת חִטִּ֖ים תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתָֽם׃ וְנָתַתָּ֤ אוֹתָם֙ עַל־ סַ֣ל אֶחָ֔ד וְהִקְרַבְתָּ֥ אֹתָ֖ם בַּסָּ֑ל וְאֶ֨ת־ הַפָּ֔ר וְאֵ֖ת שְׁנֵ֥י הָאֵילִֽם׃

passages.text: Then present Aaron and his sons at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting and wash them with water.
passages.sermon:
Aaron was the first high priest of Israel.
His sons served as priests with him.
Bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.
Wash Aaron and his sons with water at the entrance.
passages.original: וְאֶת־ אַהֲרֹ֤ן וְאֶת־ בָּנָיו֙ תַּקְרִ֔יב אֶל־ פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְרָחַצְתָּ֥ אֹתָ֖ם בַּמָּֽיִם׃

passages.text: Take the garments and clothe Aaron with the tunic, the robe of the ephod, the ephod itself, and the breastplate. Fasten the ephod on him with its woven waistband.
passages.sermon:
God chose Aaron and his sons to serve Him as priests.
God commanded Moses to prepare Aaron for this service.
Take the special garments.
Dress Aaron in the tunic.
Put the robe of the ephod on Aaron.
Put the ephod itself on Aaron.
Place the breastplate on Aaron.
Fasten the ephod to Aaron with its woven waistband.
passages.original: וְלָקַחְתָּ֣ אֶת־ הַבְּגָדִ֗ים וְהִלְבַּשְׁתָּ֤ אֶֽת־ אַהֲרֹן֙ אֶת־ הַכֻּתֹּ֔נֶת וְאֵת֙ מְעִ֣יל הָאֵפֹ֔ד וְאֶת־ הָאֵפֹ֖ד וְאֶת־ הַחֹ֑שֶׁן וְאָפַדְתָּ֣ ל֔וֹ בְּחֵ֖שֶׁב הָאֵפֹֽד׃

passages.text: Put the turban on his head and attach the holy diadem to the turban.
passages.sermon:
Aaron is the brother of Moses.
Aaron is a priest.
Take the turban.
Place the turban on Aaron’s head.
Take the holy diadem.
Attach the holy diadem to the turban.
passages.original: וְשַׂמְתָּ֥ הַמִּצְנֶ֖פֶת עַל־ רֹאשׁ֑וֹ וְנָתַתָּ֛ אֶת־ נֵ֥זֶר הַקֹּ֖דֶשׁ עַל־ הַמִּצְנָֽפֶת׃

passages.text: Then take the anointing oil and anoint him by pouring it on his head.
passages.sermon: Moses must take the anointing oil.\r\nMoses must pour the oil on Aaron’s head.\r\nMoses must anoint Aaron with the oil.
passages.original: וְלָֽקַחְתָּ֙ אֶת־ שֶׁ֣מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָ֔ה וְיָצַקְתָּ֖ עַל־ רֹאשׁ֑וֹ וּמָשַׁחְתָּ֖ אֹתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Present his sons as well and clothe them with tunics.
passages.sermon: Aaron had sons.\r\nYou must bring Aaron’s sons forward.\r\nYou must dress Aaron’s sons in tunics.
passages.original: וְאֶת־ בָּנָ֖יו תַּקְרִ֑יב וְהִלְבַּשְׁתָּ֖ם כֻּתֳּנֹֽת׃

passages.text: Wrap the sashes around Aaron and his sons and tie headbands on them. The priesthood shall be theirs by a permanent statute. In this way you are to ordain Aaron and his sons.
passages.sermon:
Aaron is the brother of Moses.
Aaron’s sons are his descendants.
God chose Aaron and his sons to be priests.
You must wrap sashes around Aaron.
You must wrap sashes around his sons.
You must tie headbands on Aaron.
You must tie headbands on his sons.
God gives the priesthood to Aaron and his sons.
This priesthood will last forever.
This is a permanent law.
You must ordain Aaron and his sons in this way.
passages.original: וְחָגַרְתָּ֩ אֹתָ֨ם אַבְנֵ֜ט אַהֲרֹ֣ן וּבָנָ֗יו וְחָבַשְׁתָּ֤ לָהֶם֙ מִגְבָּעֹ֔ת וְהָיְתָ֥ה לָהֶ֛ם כְּהֻנָּ֖ה לְחֻקַּ֣ת עוֹלָ֑ם וּמִלֵּאתָ֥ יַֽד־ אַהֲרֹ֖ן וְיַד־ בָּנָֽיו׃

passages.text: You are to present the bull at the front of the Tent of Meeting, and Aaron and his sons are to lay their hands on its head.
passages.sermon:
Aaron is the high priest of Israel.
Aaron has sons who serve as priests.
You must bring a bull.
Bring the bull to the front of the Tent of Meeting.
Aaron and his sons must come to the bull.
Aaron and his sons must place their hands on the head of the bull.
passages.original: וְהִקְרַבְתָּ֙ אֶת־ הַפָּ֔ר לִפְנֵ֖י אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְסָמַ֨ךְ אַהֲרֹ֧ן וּבָנָ֛יו אֶת־ יְדֵיהֶ֖ם עַל־ רֹ֥אשׁ הַפָּֽר׃

passages.text: And you shall slaughter the bull before the LORD at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
passages.sermon:
Moses must slaughter the bull.
He must do this before the LORD.
He must do this at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
passages.original: וְשָׁחַטְתָּ֥ אֶת־ הַפָּ֖ר לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃

passages.text: Take some of the blood of the bull and put it on the horns of the altar with your finger; then pour out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar.
passages.sermon:
Moses must take some blood from the bull.
He must use his finger.
He must put the blood on the horns of the altar.
He must pour all the remaining blood at the base of the altar.
passages.original: וְלָֽקַחְתָּ֙ מִדַּ֣ם הַפָּ֔ר וְנָתַתָּ֛ה עַל־ קַרְנֹ֥ת הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ בְּאֶצְבָּעֶ֑ךָ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ הַדָּ֣ם תִּשְׁפֹּ֔ךְ אֶל־ יְס֖וֹד הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃

passages.text: Take all the fat that covers the entrails and the lobe of the liver, and both kidneys with the fat on them, and burn them on the altar.
passages.sermon:
God gave instructions for a sacrifice at the altar.
Take all the fat that covers the entrails.
Take the lobe of the liver.
Take both kidneys.
Take the fat that is on the kidneys.
Burn all these parts on the altar.
passages.original: וְלָֽקַחְתָּ֗ אֶֽת־ כָּל־ הַחֵלֶב֮ הַֽמְכַסֶּ֣ה אֶת־ הַקֶּרֶב֒ וְאֵ֗ת הַיֹּתֶ֙רֶת֙ עַל־ הַכָּבֵ֔ד וְאֵת֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י הַכְּלָיֹ֔ת וְאֶת־ הַחֵ֖לֶב אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲלֵיהֶ֑ן וְהִקְטַרְתָּ֖ הַמִּזְבֵּֽחָה׃

passages.text: But burn the flesh of the bull and its hide and dung outside the camp; it is a sin offering.
passages.sermon:
The bull is a sin offering.
Take the flesh of the bull.
Take the hide of the bull.
Take the dung of the bull.
Burn all of these outside the camp.
passages.original: וְאֶת־ בְּשַׂ֤ר הַפָּר֙ וְאֶת־ עֹר֣וֹ וְאֶת־ פִּרְשׁ֔וֹ תִּשְׂרֹ֣ף בָּאֵ֔שׁ מִח֖וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה חַטָּ֖את הֽוּא׃

passages.text: Take one of the rams, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on its head.
passages.sermon:
Take one ram.
Aaron is the high priest.
Aaron has sons who serve as priests.
Aaron and his sons must lay their hands on the ram’s head.
passages.original: וְאֶת־ הָאַ֥יִל הָאֶחָ֖ד תִּקָּ֑ח וְסָ֨מְכ֜וּ אַהֲרֹ֧ן וּבָנָ֛יו אֶת־ יְדֵיהֶ֖ם עַל־ רֹ֥אשׁ הָאָֽיִל׃

passages.text: You are to slaughter the ram, take its blood, and sprinkle it on all sides of the altar.
passages.sermon:
God gave instructions for the ordination of priests.
He commanded Moses to use a ram for this ceremony.
Moses must slaughter the ram.
Moses must collect the blood of the ram.
Moses must sprinkle the blood on all sides of the altar.
passages.original: וְשָׁחַטְתָּ֖ אֶת־ הָאָ֑יִל וְלָֽקַחְתָּ֙ אֶת־ דָּמ֔וֹ וְזָרַקְתָּ֥ עַל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִֽיב׃

passages.text: Cut the ram into pieces, wash the entrails and legs, and place them with its head and other pieces.
passages.sermon:
Take the ram.
Cut the ram into pieces.
Wash the entrails of the ram.
Wash the legs of the ram.
Place the washed entrails with the pieces.
Place the washed legs with the pieces.
Place the head of the ram with the pieces.
passages.original: וְאֶ֨ת־ הָאַ֔יִל תְּנַתֵּ֖חַ לִנְתָחָ֑יו וְרָחַצְתָּ֤ קִרְבּוֹ֙ וּכְרָעָ֔יו וְנָתַתָּ֥ עַל־ נְתָחָ֖יו וְעַל־ רֹאשֽׁוֹ׃

passages.text: Then burn the entire ram on the altar; it is a burnt offering to the LORD, a pleasing aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.
passages.sermon:
God commanded Moses to offer a ram as a sacrifice.
Moses must burn the entire ram on the altar.
This ram is a burnt offering to the LORD.
The burnt offering pleases the LORD.
The fire consumes the offering for the LORD.
passages.original: וְהִקְטַרְתָּ֤ אֶת־ כָּל־ הָאַ֙יִל֙ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חָה עֹלָ֥ה ה֖וּא לַֽיהוָ֑ה רֵ֣יחַ נִיח֔וֹחַ אִשֶּׁ֥ה לַיהוָ֖ה הֽוּא׃

passages.text: Take the second ram, and Aaron and his sons are to lay their hands on its head.
passages.sermon:
Moses must take the second ram.
Aaron is the high priest.
Aaron’s sons are priests.
Aaron and his sons must lay their hands on the head of the second ram.
passages.original: וְלָ֣קַחְתָּ֔ אֵ֖ת הָאַ֣יִל הַשֵּׁנִ֑י וְסָמַ֨ךְ אַהֲרֹ֧ן וּבָנָ֛יו אֶת־ יְדֵיהֶ֖ם עַל־ רֹ֥אשׁ הָאָֽיִל׃

passages.text: Slaughter the ram, take some of its blood, and put it on the right earlobes of Aaron and his sons, on the thumbs of their right hands, and on the big toes of their right feet. Sprinkle the remaining blood on all sides of the altar.
passages.sermon:
Aaron was the first high priest of Israel. His sons served as priests with him.
Slaughter the ram.
Take some of the ram’s blood.
Put the blood on the right earlobe of Aaron.
Put the blood on the right earlobes of Aaron’s sons.
Put the blood on the right thumb of Aaron.
Put the blood on the right thumbs of Aaron’s sons.
Put the blood on the right big toe of Aaron.
Put the blood on the right big toes of Aaron’s sons.
Sprinkle the rest of the blood on all sides of the altar.
passages.original: וְשָׁחַטְתָּ֣ אֶת־ הָאַ֗יִל וְלָקַחְתָּ֤ מִדָּמוֹ֙ וְנָֽתַתָּ֡ה עַל־ תְּנוּךְ֩ אֹ֨זֶן אַהֲרֹ֜ן וְעַל־ תְּנ֨וּךְ אֹ֤זֶן בָּנָיו֙ הַיְמָנִ֔ית וְעַל־ בֹּ֤הֶן יָדָם֙ הַיְמָנִ֔ית וְעַל־ בֹּ֥הֶן רַגְלָ֖ם הַיְמָנִ֑ית וְזָרַקְתָּ֧ אֶת־ הַדָּ֛ם עַל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִֽיב׃

passages.text: And take some of the blood on the altar and some of the anointing oil and sprinkle it on Aaron and his garments, as well as on his sons and their garments. Then he and his garments will be consecrated, as well as his sons and their garments.
passages.sermon:
Take some blood from the altar.
Take some anointing oil.
Sprinkle the blood and oil on Aaron.
Sprinkle them on Aaron’s garments.
Sprinkle them on Aaron’s sons.
Sprinkle them on the garments of Aaron’s sons.
This act will consecrate Aaron.
This act will consecrate Aaron’s garments.
This act will consecrate Aaron’s sons.
This act will consecrate the garments of Aaron’s sons.
passages.original: וְלָקַחְתָּ֞ מִן־ הַדָּ֨ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַֽל־ הַמִּזְבֵּחַ֮ וּמִשֶּׁ֣מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה֒ וְהִזֵּיתָ֤ עַֽל־ אַהֲרֹן֙ וְעַל־ בְּגָדָ֔יו וְעַל־ בָּנָ֛יו וְעַל־ בִּגְדֵ֥י בָנָ֖יו אִתּ֑וֹ וְקָדַ֥שׁ הוּא֙ וּבְגָדָ֔יו וּבָנָ֛יו וּבִגְדֵ֥י בָנָ֖יו אִתּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Take the fat from the ram, the fat tail, the fat covering the entrails, the lobe of the liver, both kidneys with the fat on them, and the right thigh (since this is a ram for ordination), along with one loaf of bread, one cake of bread made with oil, and one wafer from the basket of unleavened bread that is before the LORD.
passages.sermon:
God gave instructions for the ordination of Aaron and his sons as priests.
Take the fat from the ram.
Take the fat tail.
Take the fat that covers the entrails.
Take the lobe of the liver.
Take both kidneys with the fat on them.
Take the right thigh.
This ram is for ordination.
Take one loaf of bread.
Take one cake of bread made with oil.
Take one wafer from the basket of unleavened bread.
This basket is before the LORD.
passages.original: וְלָקַחְתָּ֣ מִן־ הָ֠אַיִל הַחֵ֨לֶב וְהָֽאַלְיָ֜ה וְאֶת־ הַחֵ֣לֶב׀ הַֽמְכַסֶּ֣ה אֶת־ הַקֶּ֗רֶב וְאֵ֨ת יֹתֶ֤רֶת הַכָּבֵד֙ וְאֵ֣ת׀ שְׁתֵּ֣י הַכְּלָיֹ֗ת וְאֶת־ הַחֵ֙לֶב֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲלֵהֶ֔ן וְאֵ֖ת שׁ֣וֹק הַיָּמִ֑ין כִּ֛י אֵ֥יל מִלֻּאִ֖ים הֽוּא׃ וְכִכַּ֨ר לֶ֜חֶם אַחַ֗ת וַֽחַלַּ֨ת לֶ֥חֶם שֶׁ֛מֶן אַחַ֖ת וְרָקִ֣יק אֶחָ֑ד מִסַּל֙ הַמַּצּ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֖ר לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Put all these in the hands of Aaron and his sons and wave them before the LORD as a wave offering.
passages.sermon:
Moses must take all these items.
He must place them in the hands of Aaron.
He must also place them in the hands of Aaron’s sons.
Aaron and his sons must hold these items.
Moses must wave the items before the LORD.
This act is a wave offering to the LORD.
passages.original: וְשַׂמְתָּ֣ הַכֹּ֔ל עַ֚ל כַּפֵּ֣י אַהֲרֹ֔ן וְעַ֖ל כַּפֵּ֣י בָנָ֑יו וְהֵנַפְתָּ֥ אֹתָ֛ם תְּנוּפָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Then take them from their hands and burn them on the altar atop the burnt offering as a pleasing aroma before the LORD; it is an offering made by fire to the LORD.
passages.sermon:
Moses, take the items from the hands of Aaron and his sons.
Place the items on the altar.
Burn the items on top of the burnt offering.
The smoke will rise as a pleasing aroma before the LORD.
This is an offering made by fire to the LORD.
passages.original: וְלָקַחְתָּ֤ אֹתָם֙ מִיָּדָ֔ם וְהִקְטַרְתָּ֥ הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חָה עַל־ הָעֹלָ֑ה לְרֵ֤יחַ נִיח֙וֹחַ֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אִשֶּׁ֥ה ה֖וּא לַיהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Take the breast of the ram of Aaron’s ordination and wave it before the LORD as a wave offering, and it will be your portion.
passages.sermon:
Aaron is the first high priest of Israel.
God chose Aaron and his sons to serve as priests.
God commanded Moses to ordain Aaron as priest.
God commanded Moses to use a ram for Aaron’s ordination.
Take the breast from the ram used for Aaron’s ordination.
Wave the breast before the LORD as a wave offering.
This breast will belong to you as your portion.
passages.original: וְלָקַחְתָּ֣ אֶת־ הֶֽחָזֶ֗ה מֵאֵ֤יל הַמִּלֻּאִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְאַהֲרֹ֔ן וְהֵנַפְתָּ֥ אֹת֛וֹ תְּנוּפָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְהָיָ֥ה לְךָ֖ לְמָנָֽה׃

passages.text: Consecrate for Aaron and his sons the breast of the wave offering that is waved and the thigh of the heave offering that is lifted up from the ram of ordination.
passages.sermon:
Aaron was the first high priest of Israel.
Aaron had sons who also served as priests.
God commanded Moses to set apart special offerings for them.
Take the breast of the wave offering.
This breast is waved before the LORD.
Take the thigh of the heave offering.
This thigh is lifted up before the LORD.
Both the breast and the thigh come from the ram of ordination.
This ram is used to ordain Aaron and his sons as priests.
Set apart the breast and the thigh for Aaron and his sons.
passages.original: וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ֞ אֵ֣ת׀ חֲזֵ֣ה הַתְּנוּפָ֗ה וְאֵת֙ שׁ֣וֹק הַתְּרוּמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר הוּנַ֖ף וַאֲשֶׁ֣ר הוּרָ֑ם מֵאֵיל֙ הַמִּלֻּאִ֔ים מֵאֲשֶׁ֥ר לְאַהֲרֹ֖ן וּמֵאֲשֶׁ֥ר לְבָנָֽיו׃

passages.text: This will belong to Aaron and his sons as a regular portion from the Israelites, for it is the heave offering the Israelites will make to the LORD from their peace offerings.
passages.sermon:
Aaron was the first high priest of Israel.
Aaron had sons who also served as priests.
God gave Aaron and his sons a special portion.
This portion came from the people of Israel.
The Israelites brought peace offerings to the LORD.
From these offerings, the Israelites gave a heave offering.
The heave offering belonged to Aaron and his sons.
This rule was permanent for all generations.
Aaron and his sons received this portion as their regular share.
passages.original: וְהָיָה֩ לְאַהֲרֹ֨ן וּלְבָנָ֜יו לְחָק־ עוֹלָ֗ם מֵאֵת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּ֥י תְרוּמָ֖ה ה֑וּא וּתְרוּמָ֞ה יִהְיֶ֨ה מֵאֵ֤ת בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מִזִּבְחֵ֣י שַׁלְמֵיהֶ֔ם תְּרוּמָתָ֖ם לַיהוָֽה׃

passages.text: The holy garments that belong to Aaron will belong to his sons after him, so they can be anointed and ordained in them.
passages.sermon:
Aaron is the first high priest of Israel.
Aaron has special holy garments.
These holy garments belong to Aaron.
After Aaron, his sons will receive these holy garments.
Aaron’s sons will wear the holy garments after him.
The sons will use the garments when they are anointed.
The sons will use the garments when they are ordained as priests.
passages.original: וּבִגְדֵ֤י הַקֹּ֙דֶשׁ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְאַהֲרֹ֔ן יִהְי֥וּ לְבָנָ֖יו אַחֲרָ֑יו לְמָשְׁחָ֣ה בָהֶ֔ם וּלְמַלֵּא־ בָ֖ם אֶת־ יָדָֽם׃

passages.text: The son who succeeds him as priest and enters the Tent of Meeting to minister in the Holy Place must wear them for seven days.
passages.sermon:
Aaron is the high priest of Israel.
Aaron has sons.
One of Aaron’s sons will become priest after him.
This son will serve as priest in Aaron’s place.
This son will enter the Tent of Meeting.
The Tent of Meeting is the place where God’s people worship.
This son will serve in the Holy Place.
He must wear the holy garments.
He must wear these garments for seven days.
passages.original: שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֗ים יִלְבָּשָׁ֧ם הַכֹּהֵ֛ן תַּחְתָּ֖יו מִבָּנָ֑יו אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָבֹ֛א אֶל־ אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד לְשָׁרֵ֥ת בַּקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃

passages.text: You are to take the ram of ordination and boil its flesh in a holy place.
passages.sermon:
God gave instructions for ordaining priests.
You must take the ram for ordination.
You must boil the ram’s flesh.
You must do this in a holy place.
passages.original: וְאֵ֛ת אֵ֥יל הַמִּלֻּאִ֖ים תִּקָּ֑ח וּבִשַּׁלְתָּ֥ אֶת־ בְּשָׂר֖וֹ בְּמָקֹ֥ם קָדֹֽשׁ׃

passages.text: At the entrance to the Tent of Meeting, Aaron and his sons are to eat the meat of the ram and the bread that is in the basket.
passages.sermon:
Aaron is the high priest.
His sons are priests.
They must eat the meat of the ram.
They must also eat the bread in the basket.
They must do this at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
passages.original: וְאָכַ֨ל אַהֲרֹ֤ן וּבָנָיו֙ אֶת־ בְּשַׂ֣ר הָאַ֔יִל וְאֶת־ הַלֶּ֖חֶם אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּסָּ֑ל פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃

passages.text: They must eat those things by which atonement was made for their ordination and consecration. But no outsider may eat them, because these things are sacred.
passages.sermon:
Aaron and his sons must eat the meat and bread from the ordination sacrifice.
God used these things to make atonement for Aaron and his sons.
God used these things to ordain and consecrate them as priests.
No outsider may eat these things.
These things are sacred.
passages.original: וְאָכְל֤וּ אֹתָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר כֻּפַּ֣ר בָּהֶ֔ם לְמַלֵּ֥א אֶת־ יָדָ֖ם לְקַדֵּ֣שׁ אֹתָ֑ם וְזָ֥ר לֹא־ יֹאכַ֖ל כִּי־ קֹ֥דֶשׁ הֵֽם׃

passages.text: And if any of the meat of ordination or any bread is left until the morning, you are to burn up the remainder. It must not be eaten, because it is sacred.
passages.sermon:
God gave instructions for Aaron and his sons.
They must eat the meat of ordination and the bread at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
If any meat of ordination or bread remains until morning, you must burn what is left in the fire.
No one may eat the leftover meat or bread.
The leftover meat and bread are sacred.
passages.original: וְֽאִם־ יִוָּתֵ֞ר מִבְּשַׂ֧ר הַמִּלֻּאִ֛ים וּמִן־ הַלֶּ֖חֶם עַד־ הַבֹּ֑קֶר וְשָׂרַפְתָּ֤ אֶת־ הַנּוֹתָר֙ בָּאֵ֔שׁ לֹ֥א יֵאָכֵ֖ל כִּי־ קֹ֥דֶשׁ הֽוּא׃

passages.text: This is what you are to do for Aaron and his sons based on all that I have commanded you, taking seven days to ordain them.
passages.sermon:
God gave Moses commands for ordaining priests.
Aaron and his sons are the priests.
You must do everything God commanded for their ordination.
You must follow these instructions exactly.
You must do this for seven days.
You will ordain Aaron and his sons during these seven days.
passages.original: וְעָשִׂ֜יתָ לְאַהֲרֹ֤ן וּלְבָנָיו֙ כָּ֔כָה כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ צִוִּ֖יתִי אֹתָ֑כָה שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים תְּמַלֵּ֥א יָדָֽם׃

passages.text: Sacrifice a bull as a sin offering each day for atonement. Purify the altar by making atonement for it, and anoint it to consecrate it.
passages.sermon:
God commanded Moses to ordain Aaron and his sons as priests.
God told Moses to sacrifice a bull each day as a sin offering.
This sacrifice brings atonement.
Moses must purify the altar by making atonement for it.
Moses must anoint the altar.
This anointing will consecrate the altar.
passages.original: וּפַ֨ר חַטָּ֜את תַּעֲשֶׂ֤ה לַיּוֹם֙ עַל־ הַכִּפֻּרִ֔ים וְחִטֵּאתָ֙ עַל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ בְּכַפֶּרְךָ֖ עָלָ֑יו וּמָֽשַׁחְתָּ֥ אֹת֖וֹ לְקַדְּשֽׁוֹ׃

passages.text: For seven days you shall make atonement for the altar and consecrate it. Then the altar will become most holy; whatever touches the altar will be holy.
passages.sermon:
God gave Moses instructions for the altar.
Moses must make atonement for the altar for seven days.
Moses must consecrate the altar during these seven days.
After this, the altar will be most holy.
Anything that touches the altar will become holy.
passages.original: שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֗ים תְּכַפֵּר֙ עַל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ֖ אֹת֑וֹ וְהָיָ֤ה הַמִּזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ קֹ֣דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֔ים כָּל־ הַנֹּגֵ֥עַ בַּמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ יִקְדָּֽשׁ׃ס

passages.text: This is what you are to offer regularly on the altar, each day: two lambs that are a year old.
passages.sermon:
God gave instructions for offerings on the altar.
He commanded the people to offer sacrifices every day.
Each day, they must bring two lambs.
Each lamb must be one year old.
They must offer these lambs regularly on the altar.
passages.original: וְזֶ֕ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה עַל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ כְּבָשִׂ֧ים בְּנֵֽי־ שָׁנָ֛ה שְׁנַ֥יִם לַיּ֖וֹם תָּמִֽיד׃

passages.text: Offer one lamb in the morning and the other at twilight.
passages.sermon:
God commanded the priests to offer sacrifices on the altar.
The priests must offer one lamb in the morning.
The priests must offer the second lamb at twilight.
These offerings must happen every day.
passages.original: אֶת־ הַכֶּ֥בֶשׂ הָאֶחָ֖ד תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה בַבֹּ֑קֶר וְאֵת֙ הַכֶּ֣בֶשׂ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה בֵּ֥ין הָעַרְבָּֽיִם׃

passages.text: With the first lamb offer a tenth of an ephah of fine flour, mixed with a quarter hin of oil from pressed olives, and a drink offering of a quarter hin of wine.
passages.sermon:
God commanded the Israelites to offer sacrifices on the altar.
They must offer a lamb every morning.
With the first lamb, they must bring fine flour.
They must use one tenth of an ephah of fine flour.
They must mix the flour with oil.
They must use a quarter of a hin of oil from pressed olives.
They must also bring wine.
They must pour a quarter of a hin of wine as a drink offering for the lamb.
passages.original: וְעִשָּׂרֹ֨ן סֹ֜לֶת בָּל֨וּל בְּשֶׁ֤מֶן כָּתִית֙ רֶ֣בַע הַהִ֔ין וְנֵ֕סֶךְ רְבִעִ֥ית הַהִ֖ין יָ֑יִן לַכֶּ֖בֶשׂ הָאֶחָֽד׃

passages.text: And offer the second lamb at twilight with the same grain offering and drink offering as in the morning, as a pleasing aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.
passages.sermon:
God commanded the Israelites to offer sacrifices.
They must offer a second lamb every day.
They must do this at twilight.
They must prepare a grain offering with the lamb.
They must prepare a drink offering with the lamb.
They must use the same grain and drink offering as in the morning.
They must burn the offering on the altar.
The offering will make a pleasing aroma to the LORD.
The offering is made by fire to the LORD.
passages.original: וְאֵת֙ הַכֶּ֣בֶשׂ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה בֵּ֣ין הָעַרְבָּ֑יִם כְּמִנְחַ֨ת הַבֹּ֤קֶר וּכְנִסְכָּהּ֙ תַּֽעֲשֶׂה־ לָּ֔הּ לְרֵ֣יחַ נִיחֹ֔חַ אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַיהוָֽה׃

passages.text: For the generations to come, this burnt offering shall be made regularly at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting before the LORD, where I will meet you to speak with you.
passages.sermon:
God commanded the Israelites to bring a burnt offering.
They must bring this offering regularly.
They must do this for all generations.
They must bring the offering at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
The Tent of Meeting stands before the LORD.
God will meet the people there.
God will speak with them at that place.
passages.original: עֹלַ֤ת תָּמִיד֙ לְדֹרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם פֶּ֥תַח אֹֽהֶל־ מוֹעֵ֖ד לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אִוָּעֵ֤ד לָכֶם֙ שָׁ֔מָּה לְדַבֵּ֥ר אֵלֶ֖יךָ שָֽׁם׃

passages.text: I will also meet with the Israelites there, and that place will be consecrated by My glory.
passages.sermon: God is the LORD.\r\nGod will meet the Israelites there.\r\nGod will make that place holy by His glory.
passages.original: וְנֹעַדְתִּ֥י שָׁ֖מָּה לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְנִקְדַּ֖שׁ בִּכְבֹדִֽי׃

passages.text: So I will consecrate the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and I will consecrate Aaron and his sons to serve Me as priests.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to the Israelites.
God said He would make the Tent of Meeting holy.
God said He would make the altar holy.
God said He would make Aaron holy.
God said He would make Aaron’s sons holy.
God would set apart Aaron and his sons to serve Him as priests.
passages.original: וְקִדַּשְׁתִּ֛י אֶת־ אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד וְאֶת־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וְאֶת־ אַהֲרֹ֧ן וְאֶת־ בָּנָ֛יו אֲקַדֵּ֖שׁ לְכַהֵ֥ן לִֽי׃

passages.text: Then I will dwell among the Israelites and be their God.
passages.sermon: God spoke to the Israelites.\r\nGod promised to live among the Israelites.\r\nGod said, “I will be their God.”
passages.original: וְשָׁ֣כַנְתִּ֔י בְּת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְהָיִ֥יתִי לָהֶ֖ם לֵאלֹהִֽים׃

passages.text: And they will know that I am the LORD their God, who brought them out of the land of Egypt so that I might dwell among them. I am the LORD their God.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD of the Israelites.
God brought the Israelites out of the land of Egypt.
God did this so He could live among them.
The Israelites will know that God is the LORD their God.
God is the LORD their God.
passages.original: וְיָדְע֗וּ כִּ֣י אֲנִ֤י יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵיהֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר הוֹצֵ֧אתִי אֹתָ֛ם מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם לְשָׁכְנִ֣י בְתוֹכָ֑ם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽם׃פ
